children: Abu Dhabi-based BlueFive Capital has acquired a 30% equity stake in Bugatti Rimac, the producer of Bugatti supercars.

The Rimac Group, which holds a 55% stake in Bugatti Rimac said on Wednesday that a consortium led by the New York-based HOF Capital, including BlueFive Capital as its largest investor, agreed to acquire Porsche’s 45%shareholding in Rimac Group and Bugatti Rimac in April.
According to Porsche, the deal has generated proceeds of 1 billion euros ($1.16 billion) for the German automaker.
HOF now holds a 23.5% stake and has become the largest shareholder in the Rimac Group, which holds the 55% controlling interest in Bugatti Rimac.

BlueFive Capital, which said it is now the second largest shareholder in Bugatti Rimac, has not disclosed financial details of the transaction but added it will hold a board seat at Bugatti Rimac and two observer seats.

Porsche and the Croatia-headquartered Rimac Group established the Bugatti Rimac joint venture in 2021, with Rimac Group holding a 55% majority stake and Porsche holding the remaining 45%. Porsche also held a 21% shareholding in Rimac Group.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Abu Dhabi’s BlueFive Capital acquires 30% stake in supercar producer Bugatti Rimac
